comparisons.peer_summary: Commercial net charge-offs increased by $1.1 billion to $1.8 billion during 2024, primarily due to higher losses in the commercial real estate office portfolio and the U.S. commercial portfolio.
comparisons.comparison: Both Bank of America (BAC) and Morgan Stanley (MS) reported increased charge-offs in 2024 specifically linked to the commercial real estate (CRE) office sector. MS reported $25 million in charge-offs for Wealth Management CRE loans, primarily in office, while BAC reported a much larger increase in total commercial net charge-offs ($1.8 billion), also primarily driven by higher losses in the CRE office portfolio and U.S. commercial portfolio.
